'''Rakesh Sharma''' (born 2 July 1958) is an Indian banker who is the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of [[IDBI Bank]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/former-canara-bank-md-rakesh-sharma-takes-charge-as-idbi-bank-md-ceo-3031711.html|title=Rakesh Sharma is new MD & CEO of IDBI Bank|work=@mc|access-date=2018-10-11|language=en}}</ref> Sharma was the [[Chief executive officer|MD]] and [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] of [[Lakshmi Vilas Bank]] and [[Canara Bank]]. He has also held positions at [[State Bank of India]] during his 33-year tenure with the lender.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/In-a-first-two-private-bank-execs-in-race-to-head-PSBs/articleshow/48026825.cms|title=In a first, two private bank execs in race to head PSBs - Times of India|work=The Times of India|access-date=2018-06-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160325082744/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/In-a-first-two-private-bank-execs-in-race-to-head-PSBs/articleshow/48026825.cms|archive-date=2016-03-25|url-status=live}}</ref>

== Career ==
Sharma started his career with [[State Bank of India]] (SBI) as a probationary officer in 1980 and served the bank till 2014. His last position in SBI was that of Chief General Manager for Patna Circle, comprising Bihar and Jharkhand.<ref name="auto">{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiatimes.com/news/india/these-two-pvt-sector-bank-execs-are-taking-a-pay-cut-to-make-government-banks-successful-244224.html|title=These Two Pvt Sector Bank Execs Are Taking A Pay Cut To Make Government Banks Successful|work=indiatimes.com|access-date=2018-06-28|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917215533/https://www.indiatimes.com/news/india/these-two-pvt-sector-bank-execs-are-taking-a-pay-cut-to-make-government-banks-successful-244224.html|archive-date=2018-09-17|url-status=live}}</ref> Sharma has also held portfolios including lending to mid-corporate accounts in [[Andhra Pradesh]] region and supervising retail operations in the states of Rajasthan, Uttarakhand and Western UP.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/meet-the-five-persons-tasked-with-reviving-public-sector-banking-in-india/articleshow/48535496.cms|title=Meet the five persons tasked with reviving public sector banking in India|last=Mehta|first=Sangita|date=2015-08-19|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2018-06-28|last2=Sinha|first2=Shilpy|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917215539/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/meet-the-five-persons-tasked-with-reviving-public-sector-banking-in-india/articleshow/48535496.cms|archive-date=2018-09-17|url-status=live}}</ref> Earlier, he served as Chief Executive Officer of SBI Japan where he steered and directed operations of SBI branches in Tokyo and Osaka.<ref name=":0" />

Sharma joined [[Lakshmi Vilas Bank]] (LVB) as the MD and CEO in March 2014. He helmed Lakshmi Vilas Bank's rapid growth, as well as internal governance and [[mobile banking]].<ref name="auto"/>

Sharma joined [[Canara Bank]] in September 2015 as part of [[Government of India]]'s Mission Indradhanush to revive public sector banks. He has led reorganisation drive at the bank moving from a three-tier to a four-tier organisation structure.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/canara-bank-moves-to-4tier-structure/article8855914.ece|title=Canara Bank moves to 4-tier structure|work=@businessline|access-date=2018-06-28|language=en}}</ref> Sharma has raised capital for the bank through stake sales and by monetising the bank's investments in its subsidiaries such as Can Fin Homes.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/opinion/interviews/sold-26-lakh-shares-in-care-ratings-for-rs-431-crore-rakesh-sharma-canara-bank/articleshow/59435526.cms|title=Sold 26 lakh shares in Care Ratings for Rs 431 crore: Rakesh Sharma, Canara Bank|date=2017-07-04|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2018-06-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170912193725/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/opinion/interviews/sold-26-lakh-shares-in-care-ratings-for-rs-431-crore-rakesh-sharma-canara-bank/articleshow/59435526.cms|archive-date=2017-09-12|url-status=live}}</ref>

* Chairman of the Working Group on Credit Growth for Gyan Sangam<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/economy/bank-revamp-govt-ropes-in-private-players-for-ideas|title=Bank revamp: Govt ropes in private players for ideas|date=2016-03-05|work=The Indian Express|access-date=2018-06-28|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170606005340/http://indianexpress.com/article/business/economy/bank-revamp-govt-ropes-in-private-players-for-ideas/|archive-date=2017-06-06|url-status=live}}</ref>

* Member of the Governing Board of [[Institute of Banking Personnel Selection]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ibps.in/about-us/governing-board|title=:: Welcome to IBPS ::|website=www.ibps.in|language=en-US|access-date=2018-06-28}}</ref>
* Member of the Managing Committee of the Indian Banks’ Association<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iba.org.in/documents/Managing-Committee.pdf|title=Indian Banks Association - Managing Committee}}</ref>

== Awards received ==
Sharma received National Award for Excellence in lending to MSME, Micro Enterprises and PMEGP conferred on Canara Bank and presented by Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri [[Narendra Modi]] in 2016.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/mse-lending-award-for-canara-bank/article9240953.ece|title=MSE lending award for Canara Bank|work=@businessline|access-date=2018-06-28|language=en}}</ref>
